scope: Additive Unicorn L1-15 healing and paired-Pet lifecycle audit; preserve pinned pulse values without enabling an incomplete combat actor.
game_version: Official level availability through 2025-03-24; older primary L4-10 healing changes; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba; current 18.600.3 values and tick behavior unverified.

sources.title: Meet The Hero Pets!
sources.levels: Pet House 4 onward; no numerical level table
facts: Unicorn follows and heals its assigned Hero, heals one target, can heal ground and air, and has published movement speed 16.
sources.limitations: No pulse start phase, Hero-follow offset, target transition or simultaneous damage/heal order is specified.

sources.title: Home Village Balance Changes
facts: L4-10 healing changed to 58, 60, 62, 64, 66, 68, 70, matching the pinned raw healing-per-second and per-pulse fields.
sources.limitations: The source calls the values heals but does not specify whether they are per hit, per second or subject to a Hero-specific modifier.

sources.title: Welcome to Clash Anytime Update!
facts: Unicorn L11-15 and Pet House 11 were released at TH17.
sources.limitations: No L11-15 hitpoints, healing values or pulse timing are published.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: The current public support list says Unicorn follows and heals its Hero.
sources.limitations: The support page does not define pulse cadence or post-Hero-death target selection.

sources.title: Pinned Unicorn Home Village Pet record
facts: Each level has healingPerSecond and healingPerPulse; the record declares a one-second attack speed, 2.5-tile range and movement speed 16.
sources.limitations: No current client build, first-pulse phase, following position or target-loss ordering is supplied.

sources.publisher: Clash of Clans Wiki on Fandom
sources.title: Unicorn
facts: Search-index excerpt claims the Unicorn can heal other troops after its Hero is knocked out or recalled.
sources.limitations: The page was blocked on direct retrieval; no current-build reproducible transition or target priority is established. Treat only as research lead.

derivations.result: Retain raw healingPerPulse as catalogue healing_per_pulse
derivations.method: Lossless normalization of the pinned level field, independent of unsupported Core pulse scheduling.

derivations.result: Pin the numerical healing magnitudes from the official 2022 balance values
derivations.method: The seven published values match the raw healingPerSecond table; the per-second field meaning is supplied by the raw record, and no pulse-timing inference is made.

rejected_inferences.rule: Schedule the first heal at deployment plus exactly one second
rejected_inferences.reason: A cadence alone does not define the first pulse phase or simultaneous damage/heal ordering.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal the nearest other Hero or troop after assigned Hero loss
rejected_inferences.reason: The secondary claim lacks current-build target priority, range, tie-break and transition tick.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat current L11-15 healing and HP as officially verified
rejected_inferences.reason: The 2025 announcement lists levels but omits numeric values; the pinned raw commit has no current client build.

items: current-build HP and heal values, especially L11-15
first and repeat healing pulse phase and damage order
post-Hero-death or recall target selection and tie-break
collision geometry, anchors and battlefield art rights

conclusion: Unicorn L1-15 remains partial and catalogue-only. Sourced general healing behavior and older numerical values are retained, but pulse scheduling and target transitions are insufficient for a faithful deterministic Core actor.
